canonical_skills_root_note: Top-level skills/ is the universal skill SSOT in the repo and npm package. install-skill distributes into host skill dirs (~/.codex/skills, ~/.qoder/skills, ~/.grok/skills, ~/.claude/skills). Claude also gets thin slash wrappers under ~/.claude/commands. Do not edit install outputs as source.
install_discipline: Edit skill body only under skills/<id>/ (SKILL.md + references + scripts).
Edit Codex agent profiles under agents/; Claude slash wrappers under claude-commands/ only.
Claude install receives full skills under .claude/skills plus thin wrappers under .claude/commands — do not fork full procedures into commands.
After skill/command changes: node src/cli.mjs install-skill --platform all --force (or per-platform).
Never treat host install dirs (.claude, .codex, .cursor, .grok, .qoder) as edit sources or git SSOT.
Repo SSOT: skills/ + agents/ + claude-commands/. Host dirs .claude/.codex/.cursor are gitignored install outputs.

skills.note: Platforms: codex/qoder/grok (no Claude slash intentional). Docs must not say Codex-only. Host: codex-app+thread or grok-build+session; PREVIEW host-agnostic; DISPATCH needs real sandbox attestation (Phase 1 contract; Wave2 real-host still PENDING).
